title: Egyptian Queso Tagine
description: A flavorful and rich cheese dip inspired by Egyptian cuisine. This queso is slow-cooked to perfection with caramelized onions and a hint of tagine spices.
instructions: In a large saucepan, caramelize the onions over medium-low heat for 20 minutes.
Add the Egyptian tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the quick cheese until melted.
Add the grated cheese and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with quick queso.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the queso is melted and bubbly.
Serve warm with pita chips or crackers.
